title: Mace Limiterrr
description: Adds a mace limit command to the game to limit the craftable amount of maces
body:
# Mace Limiter

Mace Limiter is a simple Fabric server-side mod that limits how many maces can exist in a world.

## Features

- Limits newly crafted maces
- Tracks maces using unique IDs
- Blocks extra mace crafting once the server limit is reached
- Includes an admin command to change the limit in-game

## Commands

`/macelimit`  
Shows the current mace limit and active tracked maces.

`/macelimit <number>`  
Changes the mace limit.

Example:  
`/macelimit 3`

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API

## Notes

This mod is intended for servers. Operators/admins can change the mace limit using the command.
